governanceRule: Every consequential portfolio event must update this ledger and its generated state in the same change. Product repository, CI, deployment, runtime, credential, review, publication, and independent-verification states remain separate.

recoveryOrder.title: Keep portfolio governance self-documenting
recoveryOrder.exitCriterion: Portfolio state is generated, stale work fails, and consequential changes require the ledger.

recoveryOrder.title: Close remaining review and operator gates
recoveryOrder.exitCriterion: Review decisions and genuine operator contact, address, regulatory, and territory choices are recorded without exposing private data.

recoveryOrder.title: Separate development and prepare customers
recoveryOrder.exitCriterion: Development lifecycle tests are isolated from production and the first external-customer loop is supportable and measurable.

recoveryOrder.title: Close independent-verification gaps
recoveryOrder.exitCriterion: OpsTruth decides the exact maintenance head and AgentProof receipts remain consequence evidence rather than completion authority.

recoveryOrder.title: Advance releases and infrastructure through gates
recoveryOrder.exitCriterion: Release, governance-repository, domain-runtime, and fleet work advances only from exact authority and evidence.
